headline: The Stock Market Is Finally Rising Again—and It’s Getting Cheaper, Too
summary: In a “shrinkflation” world, investors might want to stop and appreciate the stock market, which is giving them more for less. Simply put, the “E” is rising faster than the “P.” Second-quarter earnings season has been one for the ages, with 86% of companies beating earnings estimates, above the average of 78%, and S&P 500 companies growing earnings by a startling 50.4% from one year ago, per FactSet.
